name: Cyber Insurance Questionnaires
description: Drafting tool-verified answers to cyber-insurance renewal, new-business, and underwriter security questionnaires: the standard recurring question set (MFA everywhere including privileged accounts, EDR coverage ratio, tested and immutable backups, documented and tested IR plan, security awareness training), which connected tools actually answer each one, and the evidence-backed / documented-only / unable-to-verify labeling discipline that keeps an answer defensible during a claim investigation.
